name: Gemini
description: After receiving a healing skill, an additional recovery of 6% of Health is also generated. This effect can only be triggered once every 5s.

name: Annihilation
description: Deals an additional 150% damage to enemy summons/minions.

name: Supernova
description: After releasing Ultimate for the first time, increase damage dealt by 30% for 8s.

name: Meteor Shower
description: After releasing an Ultimate, deal extra damage to 1 random enemy, equal to 1x 15% of target's current Health.

name: Spotlight
description: Hero's Attacks cannot be dodged. Additionally, every 1% of Hero Accuracy is converted into 2% of Crit Damage for the battle.

name: Full Moon
description: Whenever this Hero dodges an Attack, increase Attack Speed by 20% for 3s.

name: New Moon
description: After using an active skill, increase Dodge by 50% for 2s.

name: Aurora
description: At the beginning of the battle, the enemy Hero in the same formation position across from this Hero will have 50% less Accuracy for 5s.

name: Black Hole
description: After surpassing 300 Energy for the first time, remove all the Energy from this Hero and the Enemy with the highest Energy.

name: Maestro
description: After applying a control skill, increase Attack by 10% for 5s.

name: Deftness
description: Every 2 auto-attack hits, deal an extra 80% damage to the target. This damage is treated as True Damage.

name: Torment
description: Increases damage dealt to enemies with a debuff on them by 12%.

name: Sprout
description: 10s after the battle begins, remove all debuffs and recover 10% Health.

name: Prevail
description: If enemy's Health is more than the Hero's, reduce enemy's damage dealt by 18%. If enemy's Health is less, increase the Hero's damage dealt by 18%.

name: Panacea
description: Increase maximum Health by 30% during battle.

name: Collective Fervor
description: Whenever an ally Hero releases an Ultimate, restore 30 Energy to them and this Hero.

name: Divine-Fire
description: Increases Energy by 2 every second. This Energy does not decrease except when triggering Ultimate.

name: Self-Hypnosis
description: When healing an ally Hero, recover 20% of the overall Health recovered to the healer themselves.

name: Symbiosis
description: At the beginning of battle, gain a shield equal to 15% of this Hero's max Health for 8s.

name: Resonance
description: When this Hero is killed, stun nearby enemies for 3s.

name: Recovery
description: During the first 15s of battle, recover 4% of max Health every second.

name: Transcend
description: Dodge the first enemy damage dealt.

name: Sunder
description: Increases damage dealt to shields by 100%.

name: Savvy
description: Increases damage dealt from active skills by 25%.

name: Tenacious
description: Increases all shields' strength by 20%.

name: Waterdrop
description: Reduces Crit damage taken by 35%.

name: Wrath
description: For every 6% of Health lost, increase Attack by 1%, to a maximum of 30 stacks.

name: Phantom
description: Healing received cannot be reduced.

name: Broken Mirror
description: Reduces Hit Energy Restoration by 35% for nearby enemies.

name: Energy Field
description: Ally Hero with the highest Combat Power is immune to first lethal damage, then gains a shield with 30% of this Hero's current Health for 8s. This effect can trigger once per battle.

name: Animus
description: Auto-Attacks have a 20% chance of generating a shield equal to their damage dealt.

name: Time-lapse
description: Hero's auto-attacks have a 20% chance to stun the target for 1.5s.

name: Excitement
description: Restore 150 Energy within the first 5s of battle.

name: Vexation
description: When hitting enemy with auto-attacks, reduce their Hit Energy Restoration by 50%.

name: Engulf
description: After each of the first 2 Ultimates, Hero gains a buff which increases Lifesteal by 12%.

name: Spirit Flash
description: After the first time any enemy releases their Ultimate, generate a shield equal to 50% of max Health for 10s to protect this Hero.

name: Culmination
description: Increase Attack by 1% every 4s during battle.

name: Primal Totem
description: After releasing an Ultimate, gain immunity from control skills for 5s.

name: Death Waiver
description: The first time this Hero takes lethal damage, gain full immunity for 2s instead.

name: Inspiration
description: Whenever a skill targets an ally, increase their Attack and Defense by 10% for 5s.

name: Purify
description: When healing an ally, there is a 20% chance to remove all debuffs inflicted upon them.

name: Pristine
description: When Health is above 75%, increase Defense by 50%.

name: Embroilment
description: When Health is above 50%, increase damage dealt by 10%. When Health is below 50%, reduce damage taken by 10%.

name: Corrosion
description: When an auto-attack hits, reduce target's Defense by 30% for 5s.

name: Colossus
description: Increases Attack by amount equal to 50% of Hero's Defense during battle.
